conbody.p: If Smart Cruise Control is temporarily canceled automatically, a warning message appears on the instrument cluster, and an audible warning sounds.
Smart Cruise Control is temporarily canceled automatically when:

li.p: Your speed is above 190 km/h (120 mph) (HEV: 150 km/h (95 mph)).
Decelerating the vehicle below 20 km/h (13 mph) (MT (manual transmission), if equipped).
The vehicle is stopped for a certain period of time
You continuously engage the accelerator pedal for a certain period of time
The Smart Cruise Control operating conditions are not satisfied
When the gear is in N (Neutral), R (Reverse), P (Park), or in a non-shiftable condition.
When the Vehicle Stability Control (ESC) or ABS is turned off.
When the engine is operating at high RPM.
When the electronic parking brake (EPB) is engaged.
Engine RPM is low (MT (manual transmission) models, if equipped).

note.p: If Smart Cruise Control is temporarily canceled while the vehicle is at a standstill with the function activated, EPB (Electronic Parking Brake) may be applied.

When Smart Cruise Control is temporarily canceled, the distance from the vehicle ahead will not be maintained. Always have your eyes on the road and, if necessary, engage the brake pedal to reduce your speed and maintain a safe distance.
